title: Winning concept specified: 'GATE AND LANTERN' (K5 + grafts) — all 26 juror objections resolved; Sejmik storey now fits with a lobby corridor; 14,151 m² GFA, 146.2 M PLN incl. 5 % reserve
stages: Site ✔ (zoning, heritage, survey, geotech, trees, neighbours)
Design research ✔ (trends, visuals, boards, façades, costs)
Concept v1.1 ✔ + Sejmik storey S-3 ✔ → merge into v1.2 with stair-A fix and cost check (workflow ►)
Production ►: drawings → v1.1 (workflow ►); plans re-run after S-2; photomatch tests ✔; extra showcase renders (workflow ►)
Boards ►: Stage II 8/8 skeletons with true-scale drawings (vis pending); Stage I 2/2; tables F.15/F.14.B ✔ (draft)
Audit ►: completeness 25/44; structural & functional audit ►; jury later
notes: Drawings updated to spec v1.1 by a two-implementer workflow with independent spec-consistency checks: site plan now uses the binding M.06 tree survey (25 kept in place, 1 transplanted, 8 removed for the building, 10 dead/dying left to the arborist, 26 new), BIPV canopy over the garden terrace, lowered segment terrace attic with set-back glass balustrade, retention 157 m³.
Eco scheme and 1:50 façade section carry the v1.1 numbers (PV 415 kWp, EP ≈ 28, 58 boreholes × 91 m + energy walls/piles, dry-cooler in the segment; 0.45 m aluminium reveals instead of granite).

Interior test of the Citizens' Hall (vis 6) is honest but weak (dark, blank wall, mannequin-like figures) → detailed art-direction critique sent to the 3D agent: axis view to the garden, daylight, terrazzo/granite floor, better people.
Running: merge of Sejmik storey S-3 into v1.2 (stair-A length, cost margin), structural & functional audit (verification stage), extra showcase renders (scouting stage).
